title: Biomarkers in Lung Cancer Screening: Achievements, Promises, and Challenges

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The present review is an update of the research and development efforts regarding the use of molecular biomarkers in the lung cancer screening setting.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Biomarkers in Lung Cancer Screening: Achievements, Promises, and Challenges》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】The two main unmet clinical needs, namely, the refinement of risk to improve the selection of individuals undergoing screening and the characterization of undetermined nodules found during the computed tomography-based screening process are the object of the biomarkers described in the present review.
